{{Quote|That's it for the fighters. I enjoyed that.|MK-09, after an engagement with attacking forces|audio=Emkay-EnjoyedThat.flac|<ref name="XWA" />}}
'''MK-09''', nicknamed '''Emkay''', was a heavily modified [[MK-series maintenance droid]] owned by the [[Azzameen family]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. A brash, aggressive [[Droid/Legends|droid]] with a sense for adventure, MK-09 was intensely loyal to the Azzameen family and their company [[Twin Suns Transport Services/Legends|Twin Suns Transport Services]] and considered himself a member of the family. The family droid was modified to allow him to [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] multiple types of craft, including [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]] and [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]], and operate a [[Starship/Legends|starship's]] [[Turret/Legends|turret]] gun. Emkay felt that droids were superior to [[Sentience/Legends|organic beings]]; disgusted by the mistreatment of droids throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], he developed a dislike toward the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] due to their callous treatment of droids and often suggested that the Azzameens join the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic]], an organization he felt held droids in better respect.

He originally served solely as a [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droid]] aboard [[Azzameen Station/Legends|Azzameen Home Base]] and the family's [[YT-2000 light freighter/Legends|YT-2000]] [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] ''[[Otana/Legends|Otana]]'', but was later able to put his piloting modifications to use when family head [[Tomaas Azzameen/Legends|Tomaas Azzameen]], owner of Twin Suns Transport Services and Alliance sympathizer, determined it time to train his youngest son [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace]] in the family [[Merchant/Legends|trading]] business. Emkay, along with Ace's siblings [[Emon Azzameen|Emon]] and [[Aeron Azzameen|Aeron]], were assigned to instruct the new pilot. The droid accompanied Ace on delivery runs for the family, often encountering [[Viraxo Industries]]&mdash; an Imperial-aligned trading company and rivals to the Azzameens and their company and with whom MK-09 held great contempt.

Following the [[Death/Legends|death]] of Tomaas and the [[Imperialization/Legends|Imperialization]] of Azzameen assets after an attempted counterattack on [[Viraxo 54|Viraxo holdings]] and a [[Battle of Hospital|failed covert delivery]], the droid, along with Ace, Aeron, and Emon, sought refuge with the Alliance; Ace would eventually enlist and Emkay often visited him on his various postings aboard Alliance [[Star Cruiser/Legends|Star Cruisers]]. During these visits, the droid would track Ace's successes, maintain Ace's growing collection of souvenirs from battles, and inform Ace of upcoming family missions. The droid would again accompany Ace as he flew on these family missions, many of which were intended to assist the Rebel Alliance, albeit discreetly, as the surviving Azzameens attempted to restore their business. Emkay and the rest of the Azzameen children were betrayed by [[Antan Azzameen]], Tomaas's brother and co-owner of Twin Suns Transport Services, after Antan forged a deal with the Empire to reclaim the family business; this trap would not be successful.

MK-09 even assisted the Alliance directly on a number of missions. When the Alliance sought the capture of the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|Lambda]] [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttle]] [[Tydirium/Legends|''Tydirium'']] for use in future offensives, MK-09 flew alongside Ace in the Azzameen family's [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 freighter]] ''[[Sabra]]'' as Ace delivered [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] to an [[Outpost 327|Imperial base]] holding the shuttle. The droid also took part in the Alliance recapture of Azzameen Station from a [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] [[Falcon's Nest mercenaries|group]], and would even go on to serve alongside Ace&mdash;now a decorated pilot&mdash;as a gunner aboard the freighter [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] during the pivotal [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]].

==Biography==
===Family service===
{{Quote|Greetings Ace, come on board, I have much to tell you.|MK-09|audio=EmkayGreetings-XWA.flac|<ref name="XWA" />}}
[[File:MKSabra.jpg|thumb|left|230px|Emkay welcomes Ace to his first mission.]]
The [[Kalibac Industries]]<ref name="XWA" /> [[MK-series maintenance droid]]<ref name="Scavenger" /> MK-09 served the [[Azzameen family]] and their [[Merchant/Legends|trading]] business, [[Twin Suns Transport Services/Legends|Twin Suns Transport Services]],<ref name="XWA" /> around [[3 ABY/Legends|3 ABY]];<ref name="NEC">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''</ref> members of the family affectionately referred to the [[Droid/Legends|droid]] as Emkay.<ref name="XWA" /> During this time, MK-09 was stationed aboard the family's [[YT-2000 light freighter/Legends|YT-2000]] [[Light freighter/Legends|light freighter]] ''[[Otana/Legends|Otana]]''. When not aboard the ''Otana'', the [[Maintenance droid/Legends|maintenance droid]] served on [[Azzameen Station/Legends|Azzameen Station]] monitoring shipping information, including statistics on [[Viraxo Industries]]&mdash;competitors of Twin Suns Transport Services&mdash;and maintaining the family's [[Starship/Legends|starships]]. The droid also spent time [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] craft in the family's combat [[Flight simulator/Legends|simulator]].<ref name="XWAPrima">[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|''Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance'': Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]</ref>

In 3 ABY,<ref name="NEC" /> the droid was aboard the ''Otana'' during a delivery to the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Alliance to Restore the Republic's]] [[Echo Base/Legends|covert base]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], assisting family patriarch [[Tomaas Azzameen/Legends|Tomaas Azzameen]] as Tomaas helped the Alliance's efforts in a [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]-spanning [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|civil war]] against the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]].<ref name="XWAPrima" /> While making the delivery,<ref name="XWA" /> an [[Death Squadron/Legends|Imperial force]] led by [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]] entered the [[Hoth system/Legends|system]] and an intense [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|battle]] erupted.<ref name="NEC" /> Emkay was aboard the ''Otana'' undergoing minor updates to his systems when Tomaas and his eldest son [[Galin Azzameen/Legends|Galin]] entered the ship and prepared to leave. The three escaped the invading Imperial forces with help from the Alliance and left with the first wave of Rebel evacuees. Though the ''Otana'' was damaged in the Azzameens' flight, the ship and its crew were able to return to Azzameen Station; once home, MK-09 continued his duties.<ref name="XWAPrima" />

====Training an ace====
{{Quote|Alright, Emkay, try not to hit anything on your way out.''"<br />"''Sir, my flight record is quite unblemished!''"<br />"''I know, I'm just razzing you a little.|Emon Azzameen razzes MK-09 during Ace's training|audio=EmkayEmonRazzing-XWA.flac|<ref name="XWA" />}}
[[File:MK09-SWXWA.jpg|thumb|right|MK-09 prepares to display a family assignment.]]
Following the ''Otana''{{'s}} escape at Hoth, Tomaas determined it was time to train his youngest son, [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace]], how to fly for the family company. To assist Ace's tutelage, his father enlisted the help of two of Ace's siblings, [[Aeron Azzameen|Aeron]] and [[Emon Azzameen|Emon]],<ref name="XWA" /> and assigned MK-09 to serve Ace directly. Ace's sister Aeron [[e-mail]]ed Emkay after the droid's reassignment and told the droid he was to accompany Ace on any family missions. She also sent him data on Azzameen trade routes, starship identification material, and information on the family's modified [[Corellian Engineering Corporation/Legends|Corellian]] [[Freighter/Legends|freighters]]&mdash;including combat tactics and [[Turret/Legends|turret]] instructions for use aboard the ships&mdash;to prepare MK-09 for his new position.<ref name="XWAPrima" /> Being assigned to Ace, MK-09 displayed family mission details through his onboard [[Holoprojector/Legends|holoprojector]] and briefed the new pilot on said missions.<ref name="XWA" />

Emkay met Ace inside the cockpit of the family's [[YT-1300 light freighter/Legends|YT-1300 light freighter]] ''[[Sabra]]'' in the hangar of Azzameen Station for Ace's first [[Realspace/Legends|spaceflight]]. Aeron, in the ''Sabra''{{'s}} identical twin ship ''[[Selu]]'', accompanied Ace and the freighters made their way to pick up a pair of [[cargo canister]]s en route to [[Harlequin Station]]. Ace piloted the craft and engaged its [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]],<ref name="XWA" /> launching both him and MK-09 into their first trip through [[Hyperspace/Legends|hyperspace]].<ref name="XWAPrima" /> Arriving at Harlequin Station, Emkay observed as Ace dropped off their cargo before retrieving the return package. However, the arrival of two Viraxo-allied [[Pursuer-class enforcement ship|''Pursuer''-class enforcement ships]], the ''[[Enkidu]]'' and ''[[Gilgam]]'', interrupted the training exercise. Harlequin Station, defenseless against the Viraxo [[Pirate/Legends|raiders]] after the departure of its protection craft ''[[Kouerd]]'', called upon the Azzameens for protection. Excited at the prospect of battle, MK-09 urged Ace to intercede on the station's behalf. Eventually, the two invaders were chased off; Harlequin Station was grateful, but animosity between the Azzameens and the Viraxo was beginning to build.<ref name="XWA" />

For the next training mission, Ace would be led by his brother Emon through a series of targets for turret practice. With Ace in the [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannon]] turret of the ''Sabra'', MK-09 piloted alongside Emon's [[Firespray-31-class patrol and attack craft/Legends|''Firespray-31''-class starship]] ''[[Andrasta]]''.<ref name="XWA" /> However, Emon instructed the droid not to fire the ''Sabra''{{'s}} forward lasers, as it was a training exercise for Ace, not MK-09; this disappointed the droid.<ref name="XWAPrima" /> As Ace practiced, MK-09 adapted his piloting to Ace's shooting. Emon concluded the lesson with a trip to the resort station of [[Dunari's Rest]] to celebrate.<ref name="XWA" /> There, the Azzameens again encountered Viraxo presence in the form of the ''Enkidu'' and two [[Razor-class starfighter|''Razor''-class]] [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]]. Emon moved to engage the ''Enkidu'', leaving Ace and Emkay to fight the starfighters. As Ace destroyed one with the ''Sabra''{{'s}} turret, MK-09 rammed the other, obliterating it without the ''Sabra'' sustaining damage.<ref name="XWAPrima" /> Following the [[Starfighter combat/Legends|dogfight]], the Azzameens fled the system at the [[Casino/Legends|casino's]] request.<ref name="XWA" />

====Viraxo entanglements====
{{Quote|I say we fight. We can run rings around any Viraxo pilot!|MK-09, offering a suggestion on how to deal with an intruder|audio=EmkayRunRings-XWA.flac|<ref name="XWA" />}}
MK-09 flew his next mission with Ace when Aeron requested Ace's help after she accidentally deleted data on three areas in the [[Azzameen cargo fields|family's secret cargo fields]]. In order to rebuild the missing data, the [[Cargo container/Legends|cargo containers]] located in the fields needed to be visited and inspected manually. Co-piloting the ''Sabra'' with Ace at the helm and Aeron flying the ''Selu'' offering advice, the droid helped instruct the young Azzameen on inspecting the containers.<ref name="XWA" /> Due to his programming, MK-09 stayed silent after Ace chose a less-efficient pattern to scan the containers in the first area; instead, the droid focused on scanning the sector for any intruding forces.<ref name="XWAPrima" />

In the second field, his scanning identified the [[cargo ferry]] [[Raider (cargo ferry)|''Raider'']] attempting to steal one of the Azzameens' [[pressure tank]]s. After a brief skirmish that saw the destruction of the ''Raider'', Ace, Aeron, and Emkay finished their scan and moved to the third area, where more interlopers were discovered. Again, the ''Enkidu'' and a pair of ''Razor''-class fighters were interfering in Azzameen affairs;<ref name="XWA" /> upon their identification, Emkay moved to the ''Sabra''{{'s}} turret and disabled one of the ''Razor''s, forcing it to crash into a container.<ref name="XWAPrima" /> The ''Enkidu'', perched atop a [[Class-L cargo container]], exited the system after the ''Selu'' approached. With the area clear, scanning resumed, eventually resulting in MK-09's discovery of contraband [[Spice/Legends|spice]] planted in the container that the ''Enkidu'' accessed. Realizing this was an effort to sabotage the Azzameens and their company, MK-09 remarked that the containers in the affected fields would have to be moved. At Emkay's suggestion, Aeron took the affected container back to Azzameen Station to allow the family to decide what to do with it and with the escalating conflict with the Viraxo.<ref name="XWA" />

Eventually, [[Antan Azzameen]], brother of Tomaas and co-owner of Twin Suns Transport Services, was informed of the recent troubles with the Viraxo and the attempted sabotage. Now in charge of the company while Tomaas and Galin were out on business, he reprimanded his brother's children for provoking the Viraxo. Still, Antan devised a plan to serve some retribution to the family's rivals by using the same illegal spice used in the [[Raid on Viraxo 54|sabotage attempt]]. Aeron was to deliver the spice to the Viraxo [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] station [[Viraxo 54]] in a disguised ''Selu''&mdash;now the ''[[Venix]]'' thanks to false [[Transponder code/Legends|transponder codes]]&mdash;and Ace, Emkay, and Emon were to subsequently cause a disturbance to attract Imperial attention; Antan hoped that the discovery of the spice Aeron left in Viraxo space would cause the rival company to fall out of favor with the Empire, effectively crippling the Viraxo. Ace, again flying the ''Sabra'' with MK-09 as copilot, and Emon, flying the ''Andrasta'', exited Azzameen Station and flew to the Viraxo [[Cargo Facility 1|facility]]. The ''Selu'' and ''Andrasta'' entered the system and engaged the ''Razor''-class starfighters emerging from the base;<ref name="XWA" /> in the fight, MK-09 manned the turret gun on the ''Sabra''. From his dorsal vantage point, Emkay witnessed the ''Andrasta'' engage the ''Enkidu'' to the latter ship's destruction.<ref name="XWAPrima" />

However, the plan failed as Aeron's brothers had entered the system too early. During the following argument, the droid attempted to calm the quarreling siblings to no avail. Aeron attempted to bluff her way to the planned exit vector, but the station disabled her masquerading YT-1300 and stranded the young [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|female]]. While Emon moved his ship to retrieve her,<ref name="XWA" /> Emkay continued firing at the Viraxo starfighters to protect Ace's flank. Emon left the system after picking up Aeron; the ''Sabra'' was forced to destroy the abandoned ''Selu'' before leaving the system to avoid Imperial identification.<ref name="XWAPrima" />

====The fall of the family====
{{Dialogue|MK-09|Really! I hardly think this is the time for an argument!|Emon|Shut up, Emkay!|Aeron|Shut up, Emkay!|attr=Emkay attempts to quell a dispute between Aeron and Emon and is met with hostility|audio=ShutUpEmkay-XWA.flac|src=<ref name="XWA" />}}
Once Tomaas returned from his trip, he was shocked that Antan would use his children to exact such revenge against Viraxo Industries rather than approach a diplomatic solution. In spite of this, his father recognized Ace's piloting abilities as well as MK-09's role in training. Because of Ace's skills, Tomaas enlisted him and MK-09, along with Aeron and Emon, to fly cover for the Twin Suns Transport Services' [[GR-75 medium transport/Legends|GR-75 medium transport]] ''[[Vasudra]]'' on a mission to collect a [[Black market/Legends|black market]] shipment of the healing substance [[Bacta/Legends|bacta]] for the Alliance from a [[Loose Cannon pirates|pirate group]]. The Azzameen flight group was escorted to the meeting grounds by the [[SCT Scout craft]] ''[[Ravenno]]''; the ''Vasudra'' docked with the waiting [[Xiytiar-class heavy transport/Legends|''Xiytiar''-class transport]] [[End Run (Xiytiar-class)|''End Run'']] and the bacta transfer began.<ref name="XWA" />

Azzameen suspicions rose as problems with the pumps were reported and technicians from the ''End Run'' were dispatched. Their suspicions were confirmed as the technicians made their way to the ''Vasudra''{{'s}} engines, intending to cripple the [[Transport/Legends|transport]]; as the family realized this, a [[DP20 gunship/Legends|DP20 gunship]], the ''[[Loose Cannon]]'', and its [[CloakShape fighter/Legends|CloakShape fighter]] escort entered the system and engaged Azzameen forces.<ref name="XWA" /> Ace, in the ''Sabra'', was told to engage the technicians; Emkay, not receiving targeting commands, targeted and engaged the attacking CloakShape starfighters.<ref name="XWAPrima" /> After the Azzameens defeated the pirate craft, the ''End Run'' surrendered and transferred the remainder of its bacta cargo.<ref name="XWA" /> The pirates then escaped at Tomaas's insistence, much to both Emon and MK-09's chagrin.<ref name="XWAPrima" />

When it was time to deliver some of the procured bacta, Tomaas called upon Ace and Emkay to fly as escorts for the ''Vasudra'' in the ''Otana''<ref name="XWA" />&mdash;the Azzameen ship the droid most wanted to pilot&mdash;<ref name="XWAPrima" /> and the craft flew to the Alliance outpost [[Hospital (XQ2 Platform)|''Hospital'']]. However, shortly after the family's arrival, the [[Imperial II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Corrupter (Imperial-class)|''Corrupter'']] entered the system; now under Alliance scrutiny due to the timing, the Azzameen escort ships were nevertheless called to assist Alliance starfighters to [[Battle of Hospital|defend]] both the outpost and the ''Vasudra'', now attempting to offload its bacta cargo.<ref name="XWA" /> Emkay assisted Ace in the ''Otana'' by monitoring communications and targeting enemies. Though a majority of their personnel escaped, the Rebellion lost the battle; ''Hospital'' was destroyed, and the ''Otana'' fled the system. The ''Vasudra'', disabled in the battle, did not return to Azzameen Station; Tomaas and Galin, both still aboard the ship, were considered lost.<ref name="XWAPrima" />

Shortly after, warrants for the Azzameen family were issued due both to their assistance at ''Hospital'' and their interference at Viraxo 54, and the family made preparations to [[Imperialization of Azzameen assets|flee]] their holdings.<ref name="XWA" /> While not one of the members of the family listed in the warrant, MK-09 considered himself to be among them.<ref name="XWAPrima" /> Ace and Emkay, in the ''Otana'', accompanied Aeron in the ''Selu'' to retrieve property from the family company's main base of operations, [[Twin Suns Station (space station)|Twin Suns Station]].<ref name="XWA" /> As Ace piloted the ''Otana'' to retrieve a container of [[Warhead/Legends|warheads]] intended for the Alliance, his droid copilot scanned the sector and was the first to announce the arrival of a joint Imperial and Viraxo strike force.<ref name="XWAPrima" /> Comprised of the Imperial [[Victory II-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Victory II''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Furious (Victory II-class)|''Furious'']], the Viraxo [[CR90 corvette/Legends|CR90 corvette]] ''[[Blast Radius]]'', and miscellaneous escorts and [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]], this [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] approached Twin Suns Station, intending to [[Imperialization/Legends|capture]] the base. The ''Otana'', warheads in tow, held off the attackers long enough for Aeron to empty the family's safe aboard the station; their mission a success, the two freighters exited the system as the station was disabled.<ref name="XWA" />

The ''Otana'' and ''Sabra'' returned to Azzameen Station. Upon arrival, Ace assessed the warhead container and found that it escaped the battle without damage. Emkay suggested a more prudent approach to the battle, which earned the droid the disabling of his communication circuits&mdash;both internal and external.<ref name="XWAPrima" /> The pilots of two [[Corellian/Legends|Corellian]] freighters met with Emon, who had been patrolling the sector. He reported that their uncle Antan, who had just flown with Emon to one of the Azzameen's cargo facilities, had been captured after an ambush by Viraxo forces. Without Antan, the Azzameen children had no plan.<ref name="XWA" /> Emkay, still silent due to his disabled circuits, was thankful for the sudden arrival of [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Garreth Holtz/Legends|Garreth Holtz]] in the ''Corrupter'', as he realized it kept the children from formulating a plan, as the past several had failed.<ref name="XWAPrima" /> With the [[Star Destroyer/Legends|Star Destroyer]] ordering the Azzameens' surrender, Aeron quickly suggested that the Azzameens seek asylum with the Alliance to Restore the Republic, hopeful that the word of family friend and Alliance pilot [[Olin Garn]] would assuage any possible suspicion from the botched bacta delivery;<ref name="XWA" /> at some point, MK-09's communication circuits were restored, and he agreed, loading the coordinates provided into the ''Otana''{{'s}} [[Navigation computer/Legends|navicomputer]]. Their exit vector took them through the path of the Imperial force; MK-09's communication circuits were again disabled after he called out the opposing ships.<ref name="XWAPrima" /> Eventually the Azzameens made their way into Alliance space in the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]] and approached the [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] [[Defiance/Legends|''Defiance'']].<ref name="XWA" />

===Aiding a rebellion===
{{Quote|So, Aeron, your friend Olin hasn't been around lately. Why?''"<br />"''I didn't want to say, but he's joined the Rebellion as a pilot.''"<br />"''Really? Wow! We should do that! I'll bet one of us could be the next Luke Skywalker!''"<br />"''Who?''"<br />"''You know, the guy in the bootleg holo Olin showed us. The guy who took out the Death Star at Yavin!''"<br />"''Well, I hate to rain on your parade, Emkay&hellip; but I don't think the Alliance is accepting droids as pilots.|MK-09 and Aeron discuss their friend Olin Garn and his involvement with the Rebel Alliance.|audio=EmkayAeronOlin-XWA.flac|<ref name="XWA" />}}
[[File:Mk09pilot.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Emkay, copiloting the ''Sabra'']]
As suspected, Olin Garn's word allowed the Azzameens clearance to come aboard the [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[MC80A Home One Type Heavy Star Cruiser/Legends|MC80 Star Cruiser]]. Ace made contact with Rebel trainers once aboard and enlisted in the Alliance naval forces.<ref name="XWA" /> As Ace's siblings worked on reestablishing the family's affairs, Emkay would pilot the ''Otana'' when called to do so. Though MK-09 could not accompany Ace when the Azzameen boy joined the Rebellion&mdash;disappointing the droid&mdash;the droid would often visit Ace as he trained and would offer tips on the trials in the Alliance's [[Pilot proving grounds|proving grounds]] and track the new recruit's kills.<ref name="XWAPrima" /> MK-09 also continued to monitor Ace's growing collection of souvenirs, stored aboard one of the family's [[Corellia/Legends|Corellian]] freighters. When visiting the ''Defiance'', MK-09 would situate himself in the concourse to alert Ace to e-mails received and inform him if the family needed the Alliance pilot.<ref name="XWA" />

====Family business====
{{Quote|Time to leave this party, Ace. Let's get outta here!|MK-09 urges Ace to leave after successfully completing an assignment|audio=EmkayLeaveParty-XWA.flac|<ref name="XWA" />}}
One such family brief came shortly after Ace's starfighter career began. After receiving word on the captured Antan's location from an Azzameen mole located aboard the Viraxo [[XQ5 Platform]] [[Viraxo Industries (platform)|''Viraxo Industries'']],<ref name="XWA" /> Emon sent MK-09, piloting the ''Otana'', back to the ''Defiance'' to collect Ace for a [[Rescue of Antan Azzameen|mission]] to rescue Antan.<ref name="XWAPrima" /> After the ''Otana'' rendezvoused with Emon's ''Andrasta'', the two craft left for the platform.<ref name="XWA" /> At Ace's command, MK-09 entered the ''Otana''{{'s}} turret and prepared to protect the YT-2000 against starfighter attacks, though the two intended to make their way to the platform without incident. However, multiple [[Planetary Defender starfighter]]s intercepted both Azzameen craft, forcing the ''Andrasta'' to engage and protect the ''Otana''.<ref name="XWAPrima" />

Once docked with ''Viraxo Industries'', Emkay disembarked the ''Otana'' to retrieve Antan from his cell.<ref name="XWA" /> The droid made his way through the facility, disabling security systems and eventually freeing the captive Azzameen.<ref name="XWAPrima" /> Once the two exited the platform and reunited with the waiting Ace, the ''Otana'' was forced to flee as a Star Destroyer entered the system. Eventually, after transferring Antan to the ''Andrasta'',<ref name="XWA" /> Emkay dropped Ace off at the ''Defiance'' and piloted the ''Otana'' back to the other Azzameens.<ref name="XWAPrima" />

Emkay would again pilot the ''Otana'' to retrieve Ace, now a [[Flight officer/Legends|flight officer]], from the ''Defiance'' for another family [[Mission to the Saila Na system|mission]], this time assigned by Aeron.<ref name="XWAPrima" /> The two would be retrieving a [[Damaged Viper probe droid|damaged]] [[Viper probe droid/Legends|Viper probe droid]] in the [[Saila Na system/Legends|Saila Na system]], which she suggested would prove useful in tracking Viraxo movements. Shortly after exiting hyperspace close to the probe [[Predator I|droid pod]], the [[Muurian transport]] ''[[Pelican]]'' and its [[Scavenger (pirate squadron)|escort]] of [[R-41 Starchaser]]s entered the system with seemingly the same mission goals. The incoming starfighters intercepted the ''Otana'' and the ''Pelican'' approached and captured the probe droid.<ref name="XWA" /> Emkay, controlling the ''Otana''{{'s}} turrets, engaged the Starchasers as Ace concentrated on destroying the transport and collecting the probe.<ref name="XWAPrima" />

With the probe retrieved, Ace and Emkay moved on to the second phase of the plan: passing through the civilian customs checkpoint [[Tinoon Station]]. While Emkay initially feared that passing the checkpoint would be the most challenging part of Aeron's plan, a pirate force consisting of [[BTL Y-wing starfighter/Legends|Y-wings]] and a pair of ''Marauder''-class corvettes entered the sector and [[Skirmish above Tinoon|engaged]] both the ''Otana'' and the [[Golan II Space Defense SpaceGun|station]]. Due to either the pressing odds, importance of the mission, or the lack of necessity in protecting the customs station, Emkay acted somewhat against his typical nature, as he suggested more than once that they fly through the screen and into hyperspace, avoiding any sort of combat entirely.<ref name="XWA" /> However, the suggestions were ignored and Emkay was dispatched to the turret to destroy offending starfighters and incoming warheads.<ref name="XWAPrima" /> Once the fight ended, Tinoon Station thanked the crew of the ''Otana'' for their support in the battle and allowed them to pass the checkpoint without incident or inspection. Leaving Tinoon Station, the ''Otana'' and the [[Probe droid/Legends|probe droid]] pod successfully rendezvoused with Aeron, who was waiting aboard the ''Sabra'' in an [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]].<ref name="XWA" /> After the exchange, the ''Otana'' returned to the ''Defiance''.<ref name="XWAPrima" />

====Aboard the ''Liberty''====
{{Quote|I've missed you, kiddo, since you joined the Rebellion. I hear of so much activity going on&hellip; I worry about you.''"<br />"''Do you worry about me, too?''"<br />"''Of course I do, Emkay. You're expensive to repair.''"<br />"''I will delete that remark from my memory banks.|Aeron, originally referring to Ace, playfully teases MK-09|audio=R030501-5.flac|<ref name="XWA" />}}
MK-09 continued to visit Ace after the latter's transfer to the Alliance [[Star Cruiser/Legends|Star Cruiser]] [[Liberty/Legends|''Liberty'']] due to the flight officer's outstanding mission performance. Some time after the transfer, Emon sent Emkay to the ''Liberty'' in the ''Otana'' to retrieve Ace for a family mission. Emon relayed that Antan had discovered that [[K'Armyn Viraxo]], head of Viraxo Industries, would be traveling in his [[Personal Luxury Yacht 3000/Legends|personal luxury yacht]] ''[[Highroller]]''. Antan saw this as a ripe [[Assassination attempt on K'Armyn Viraxo|opportunity]] for vengeance against the Viraxo for their role in the Imperialization of Azzameen assets and the [[Death/Legends|deaths]] of Tomaas and Galin.<ref name="XWA" />

By now, the thrill of piloting the ''Otana'' had waned for Emkay, and he began to resent his job of shuttling Ace to various missions&mdash;though the droid was still fond of flying as copilot in battle. Nevertheless, he complied and the ''Otana'' set off to rendezvous with Emon's ''Andrasta''. Once reunited, the two craft made their way to [[Destreg Spaceport]] in orbit around the planet [[Destreg II]], where Antan believe the ''Highroller'' would be passing through. Indeed, shortly after the brothers' arrival, the yacht, along with an escort of R-41 Starchasers, entered the [[Destreg system/Legends|system]].<ref name="XWA" /> The fighters turned to engage an oncoming ''Otana'', but, rather than fight them, Ace piloted the craft through the fighter screen; Emkay, expecting a fight, was impressed with the Alliance pilot's tactics.<ref name="XWAPrima" /> When the ''Otana'' reached the ''Highroller'', MK-09 performed a scan for lifeforms but found none aboard the craft.<ref name="XWA" /> Though disappointed and frustrated, Ace nevertheless destroyed the vessel and engaged the incoming R-41 fighters.<ref name="XWAPrima" />

Displeased with the exchange of fire, the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] called Imperial authorities and demanded the Azzameens' departure. However, before they could leave, a small collection of [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunters]] flying Muurian transports and [[Z-95 Headhunter/Legends|Z-95 Headhunters]] entered the system to collect on the Viraxo [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on the Azzameen brothers.<ref name="XWA" /> Ace, Emon, and MK-09 successfully defeated this bounty hunter force and returned to the ''Liberty''.<ref name="XWAPrima" /> Afterward, Ace and MK-09 received word from Antan, who apologized for his misinformation and for sending them into the bounty hunter trap.<ref name="XWA" />

====Alliance suppliers====
{{Quote|I am sure your uncle would be very upset to hear that you&mdash;''"<br />"''Emkay! It is so important to your future that you do not finish that sentence.''"<br />"''Yes ma'am.|Emkay and Aeron discuss her deal with the Rebel Alliance|audio=EmkayAeronUpsetUncle-XWA.flac|<ref name="XWA" />}}
[[File:MK09wearsACBA.jpg|thumb|right|Emkay wears Ace's Alliance Civilian Battle Award.]]
Following their campaign to track and destroy the [[TIE Experimental Project]] and its [[Obsidian (XQ1 Platform)|production facility]], the Alliance was in desperate need of warheads and began looking towards external and unorthodox methods to obtain the ordnance. Aeron, noting this as an opportunity to simultaneously help the Rebel Alliance and hurt Viraxo Industries, discovered a cache of warheads stored in [[Class-A cargo container|containers]] at the Viraxo [[XQ3 Platform|storage platform]] [[1]]; with Antan's permission and a collection of [[Container transport|transports]] from their company, she formed a plan to steal the containers and sell them to the Alliance.<ref name="XWA" />

MK-09 and Aeron traveled to the ''Liberty'', this time flying the ''Sabra'', and collected Ace for the mission to covertly inspect the containers.<ref name="XWA" /> As Emkay noted, the Azzameens were not adept at clandestine maneuvers, and the covert operation was unsuccessful; Viraxo ''Razor''-class fighters attacked the ''Sabra'', and Ace was forced to rapidly scan the containers while under attack. With Aeron in the turret of the ''Sabra'', MK-09 relayed information to Ace in the cockpit, and offered to control the turret in Aeron's stead when Ace's patience with the droid began to wear thin.<ref name="XWAPrima" /> With the scanning of the containers complete, the ''Sabra'' was free to fully engage the enemy starfighters and [[Gun Emplacement]]s around the facility as the [[Magnum Group]] transports entered the system.<ref name="XWA" />

Before the warhead transfers were complete, though, the intended recipients of the weapons entered the system. While MK-09 was unable to determine their origin, Aeron noted that the newcomers&mdash;the [[Bulk freighter/Legends|bulk freighter]] ''[[XTS-673]]'' and a complement of [[Supa Fighter]]s&mdash; were part of the criminal organization [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]]. Aeron also realized that the arrival of the Black Sun flight group indicated that the Azzameens had again fallen into a trap. The ''Sabra'' moved to intercept the bulk freighter and the fighters; due to Ace's distraction, Magnum group was able to complete the transfer and return safely to the Rebel rendezvous point, and the ''Sabra'' followed shortly thereafter. Both Ace and Aeron received the [[Alliance Civilian Battle Award]] for their independent civilian actions in securing the arms and assisting the Rebellion; Ace would pin his upon Emkay when the droid was aboard the ''Liberty''.<ref name="XWA" />

During Ace's continuing tour, his squadron was called upon to investigate an Imperial sensor station and [[Kuat Facility|research facility]] located near [[Kuat/Legends|Kuat]]. Antan heard of the attack on the sensor station&mdash;an Alliance success&mdash;and decided to use the confusion sown and decrease in protection to install a listening device on one of the [[Satellite/Legends|satellites]] damaged by the battle.<ref name="XWA" /> Aeron took MK-09 along in the ''Sabra'' to again meet her brother Ace aboard the ''Liberty'',<ref name="XWAPrima" /> and the trio left for [[Kuat system/Legends|Kuati space]]. Ace and Emkay dispatched the protecting forces, consisting of the [[Beta-class ETR-3 escort transport|''Beta''-class escort transport]] [[Minelayer (Beta-class ETR-3 escort transport)|''Minelayer'']] and an accompaniment of [[Alpha-class Xg-1 Star Wing/Legends|''Alpha''-class Xg-1 Star Wings]], and began searching for a location for the listening device. Once a [[Commsat-6|suitable satellite]] was found, Aeron disembarked from the freighter and began attaching the device. The ''Sabra'' was forced to protect the vulnerable Azzameen as the [[Gamma-class assault shuttle/Legends|''Gamma''-class assault shuttle]] [[Omicron (shuttle)|''Omicron'']] entered the system and deployed squads of [[Zero-G assault stormtrooper|Zero-G spacetroopers]]; after defeating these invaders and collecting Aeron, the group left the system. Emkay and Aeron dropped Ace off at the ''Liberty''<ref name="XWA" /> before departing in the ''Sabra''.<ref name="XWAPrima" />

Some time later, Aeron once again noted an opportunity to assist the Rebellion, harm the Viraxo, and make a few credits in the process. She planned to attack and raid Viraxo Industries platform [[VXO-33274]], stealing vital supplies, and then transport them to [[Vergesso Base]] to assist the struggling Rebel presence.<ref name="XWA" /> Taking MK-09 along in the ''Otana'', Aeron collected Ace from the ''Liberty''<ref name="XWAPrima" /> and the Azzameen trio traveled to the repair yards of [[Bilbringi V]], where they were to rendezvous with a motley group of freighters commanded by former employees of Twin Suns Transport Services. Following the meeting, the ''Otana'' escorted these freighters through hyperspace to VXO-33274, where the ship encountered a small Black Sun force of Supa Fighters and the [[IPV-1 System Patrol Craft]] [[Scylla (IPV-1 System Patrol Craft)|''Scylla'']] protecting the platform. With assistance from a [[SecForce Squadron|hired squadron]] of [[Toscan 8-Q starfighter]]s,<ref name="XWA" /> Ace eliminated the patrol craft from a turret aboard the ''Otana'' as MK-09 piloted the ship.<ref name="XWAPrima" /> While the Azzameen-allied craft attempted to dispatch the remaining Supa Fighters protecting the base, [[Juno (cargo ferry group)|Juno group]] and [[Lara (group)|Lara group]] entered the system and began making off with containers surrounding platform VXO-33274.<ref name="XWA" />

Before they could escape to the Vergesso Asteroids, though, a larger Black Sun force, consisting of the ''Marauder''-class corvette ''[[Charybdis]]'' and a complement of ''Razor''-class and Supa starfighters, appeared.<ref name="XWA" /> With Ace back in the pilot's seat of the ''Otana'', he and Emkay concentrated their attention on the ''Razor''-class starfighters, destroying all twelve between the two of them.<ref name="XWAPrima" /> After the elimination of all Black Sun forces in the area, Juno Group and Lara Group completed their collection assignment and made the jump to Vergesso Base;<ref name="XWA" /> the ''Otana'' followed, as Aeron needed to be delivered to the [[asteroid base]] as well. After a brief skirmish with a number of Supa fighters, Aeron successfully disembarked and the ''Otana'' returned to the ''Liberty''.<ref name="XWAPrima" />

====Darker times for the family====
{{Quote|Otana, this is Aeron! Do you read? Ace, is that you?''"<br />"''We read you Aeron. Did someone call for a ride?''"<br />"''Stow it Emkay! Get your rusted bolts over here!|A panicked Aeron, trapped aboard Vergesso Base, hails MK-09|audio=R040308-10.flac|<ref name="XWA" />}}
[[File:AceRescue-dat15210-32-XWA.png|thumb|left|Ace and MK-09 rush to rescue Aeron from Vergesso Prime.]]
Shortly after the Azzameen equipment transfer at Vergesso Base, a large fleet of Star Destroyers and support craft,<ref name="XWA" /> including the massive [[Executor-class Star Dreadnought/Legends|Super Star Destroyer]] [[Executor/Legends|''Executor'']],<ref name="SOTE">[[Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire (novel)|''Star Wars: Shadows of the Empire'' novel]]</ref> [[Battle of the Bajic Shipyards|attacked]] the rebel base. Aeron, still aboard the asteroid base, frantically contacted Emkay and informed her of her plight.<ref name="XWA" /> The droid, sitting aboard the ''Otana'', then alerted and retrieved Ace and the two set out for the asteroid base,<ref name="XWAPrima" /> reusing the course utilized in the ship's recent trip.<ref name="XWA" />

Due to the presence of the immense battlecruisers, the ''Otana'' had exited hyperspace much further from the asteroid base than anticipated; this distance forced the pair to navigate through the [[Capital ship/Legends|capital ship]] screen in order to reach Aeron. Barely escaping attacks from the Imperial forces, Ace finally piloted the ''Otana'' to a close enough proximity to receive Aeron's panicked signal from aboard the doomed asteroid. As Ace piloted, Emkay took to the freighter's turret, protecting the ''Otana'' from incoming attacks. MK-09 managed to score several kills, though they, as usual, would be attributed to Ace.<ref name="XWAPrima" /> Eventually, the ''Otana'' reached the damaged but as-of-then intact base and docked with the north tower airlock;<ref name="XWA" /> MK-09 left the transport, sought out Aeron, retrieved her, and directed her back to the ship.<ref name="XWAPrima" /> Once the two were aboard with Ace, the ''Otana'' fled the doomed station en route to the exit vector&mdash;again located beyond the Star Destroyers. Once clear of the ''Executor'', Ace engaged the hyperdrive and the Azzameen trio escaped. Safely in hyperspace, Aeron congratulated her brother and playfully insulted MK-09 as the ''Otana'' returned to the ''Liberty''.<ref name="XWA" />

MK-09, having been out of the action for some time and longing to rejoin the fray,<ref name="XWAPrima" /> would later be contacted by [[Dunari]], a longtime friend of Tomaas Azzameen.<ref name="XWA" /> After picking Ace up from the ''Liberty'', the droid relayed the message;<ref name="XWAPrima" /> solemnly, Dunari stated that Ace's brother Emon had been captured and was held in [[Quesna Base]] under Imperial charges. Following Dunari's plan, Ace and Emkay, flying the ''Otana'', anonymously transported a bomb, stolen from an [[Stockyard|Imperial stockyard]] and disguised as a [[Tibanna/Legends|Tibanna]] gas container, which would detonate when approaching the [[Cargo Facility 2|station]]. With the station distracted by the chaos of the explosion, Dunari's Muurian transport ''[[Deadman's Hand]]'' docked with Quesna Base and Dunari made his way through the station to rescue Emon.<ref name="XWA" /> Ace turned turret controls over to Emkay as the former protected the ''Deadman's Hand''. As Ace took on the IPV-1 System Patrol Craft [[Hammer (IPV-1 System Patrol Craft)|''Hammer'']], the droid scored three kills against the attacking [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE/LN fighters]]. With the station's defenses extinguished, Dunari left Quesna Base with Emon aboard his transport, and departed the station completely undamaged.<ref name="XWAPrima" /> The two ships parted ways, Ace and Emkay returning to the ''Liberty'' and Dunari taking the beaten and injured Emon to his casino. Unfortunately for Dunari and Emon, an Imperial [[Battle of Dunari's Rest|counterattack]] would force the evacuation of Dunari's Rest; Ace's squadron was called in to protect the craft leaving the doomed casino. Emkay was unable to assist in this battle, as Ace utilized his one-man Alliance fighter,<ref name="XWA" /> but did assist in cleanup at the Azzameen outpost, where Dunari's men briefly stayed following the evacuation.<ref name="XWAPrima" />

===The Azzameens strike back===
{{Quote|Make sure to protect Emkay.''"<br />"''Yes, I would like that very much.|Emon, instructing Ace, and MK-09 after a surprise mercenary attack while the latter conducts a spacewalk|audio=EmkayEmonProtect-XWA.flac|<ref name="XWA" />}}
[[File:MK09Model.jpg|thumb|right|170px|MK-09 in space, en route to the family's datacore]]
Emkay was contacted by Aeron shortly after the battle at Dunari's Rest after she determined that [[Mission to recover Comm Datacore|recovering]] files from the [[Comm Datacore|family's discarded datacore]] would assist in tracking the leak of information on family activities. After retrieving Ace in the ''Otana'',<ref name="XWAPrima" /> the two met with a recovered Emon en route to [[Junkyard Control]],<ref name="XWA" /> a scrapyard near [[Tolig IV]],<ref name="XWAPrima" /> where Aeron had tracked the datacore. After Ace identified the datacore among the refuse, Emkay left the ''Otana'' through the dorsal airlock and made his way through the short expanse of space to the junk container holding the [[Datacore/Legends|datacore]]. Shortly after his exit, however, a group of [[R60 T-wing interceptor|T-wing interceptors]] entered the system and made their way to the Azzameens. Emon and Ace defended MK-09, still slicing the datacore to find the necessary files through the hail of lasers and spacecraft.<ref name="XWA" />

His download complete, MK-09 detached from the container before locating Ace; realizing that the ''Otana'' was still occupied in its dogfight, Emkay began sailing into open space, sending out calls for assistance all the while. Eventually, with the fighters destroyed, Ace piloted the ''Otana'' toward the prone droid. Much to Emon's amusement and MK-09's dismay, the ''Otana'' sped towards the latter at full speed, only slowing the craft moments from impact to allow MK-09 to board.<ref name="XWAPrima" /> The pair of Azzameen craft exited the system, their mission a success, and Ace returned to the ''Liberty'' as Emon took the data with him to be analyzed.<ref name="XWA" />

====Assistance to the Alliance====
{{Quote|Okay, we're here. There's the ''Redhawk''&hellip; and there's&hellip; our home. This can't be right&hellip; Emkay?''"<br />"''I've double-checked the coordinates, there is no doubt.''"<br />"''Our home has become a base for mercenaries?!|Aeron and MK-09 find the mercenary base of operations|audio=R060254-58.flac|<ref name="XWA" />}}
Emkay would begin helping the Rebellion directly soon after. A [[Falcon's Nest mercenaries|mercenary group]] had been constantly harassing Alliance endeavors in several systems, so the Alliance entrusted Ace, Aeron, and Emkay with locating the [[Mercenary/Legends|mercenary]] headquarters. The trio left in the ''Otana'', planning to board the [[Bulk cruiser/Legends|bulk cruiser]] ''[[Redhawk]]''&mdash;known to have ties to the mercenary group and currently docked with the XQ5 Platform [[Cargo Station]]&mdash;and obtain the flight logs within its central [[Computer/Legends|computer]] in order to [[Reconnaissance of mercenary base|locate]] the base. This plan worked without much hassle, though an escort of [[Preybird-class starfighter|''Preybird''-class starfighters]] entered the system and began attacking the docked light freighter. MK-09 expressed a desire to enter one of the turrets to fend off this threat but was unable to as he was downloading data from the bulk freighter; instead, Ace took to the turrets to repel the attacking mercenaries.<ref name="XWA" />

Once Aeron had completed the download and reboarded the ship, the sliced coordinates were entered into the ''Otana''{{'s}} navigation computer and the trio set off. Unfortunately for the Azzameens, the flight log had altered, as noted by Emkay; rather than a mercenary base, the Azzameens found themselves in the midst of a collection of Star Destroyers firing their [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]]. MK-09's sensors indicated that the YT-2000 had entered the [[Carida/Legends|Carida]] Training Facility instead of their intended destination. Ordered to stand down, the Imperial Star Destroyers continued their bombardment of the target&mdash;now including the ''Otana''&mdash;forcing Ace into a series of evasive maneuvers to give Emkay time to create a new exit vector.<ref name="XWA" /> In addition to finding an escape route, MK-09 managed to identify the five Star Destroyers.<ref name="XWAPrima" /> Once complete, Ace ignored the Imperial order to stop and instead made haste towards this exit, located behind the wall of Star Destroyers.<ref name="XWA" />

After evading the turbolaser fire and fighter patrols sent to capture the ''Otana'', the Azzameens finally exited the [[Carida system/Legends|Carida system]] and returned to the XQ5 Platform where the ''Redhawk'' was stationed only minutes before. The bulk cruiser, however, was absent upon the ''Otana''{{'s}} re-arrival, as it had left the station towards the mercenary base. Aeron decided to check through the flight logs aboard the platform, leaving Ace in the gunnery station and Emkay managing the download. With the information on the ''Redhawk''{{'s}} whereabouts collected and input into the navicomputer, the ''Otana'' left, avoiding station defenses, and entered hyperspace.<ref name="XWA" /> Upon arrival at these new coordinates the trio was stunned to find that the mercenary base holding the [[Hurrim]] mercenaries was none other than their own former home, Azzameen Station. The station had been renamed "''Falcon's Nest''" and a scattered assortment of craft and static defenses now occupied the sector;<ref name="XWAPrima" /> Ace flew the ''Otana'' close enough to inspect the station, prompting several mercenary fighters to engage the freighter. Though Ace immediately attempted to engage this offensive presence&mdash;feelings shared by Emkay&mdash;Aeron simply wanted to return to the ''Liberty'' and inform the Rebellion so that a proper counterattack could commence. Ace agreed with Aeron's suggestion and the trio returned to the ''Liberty''.<ref name="XWA" />

====Returning home====
{{Quote|I am picking up a few fighters and some gun platforms. I thought there would be more.|MK-09, expressing a deflated hope of a more epic battle to recover his home|audio=EmkayExpectedMore-XWA.flac|<ref name="XWA" />}}
[[File:Ace_and_MK.jpg|thumb|left|MK-09, copiloting the ''Otana'' with Ace at the helm]]
The [[Battle of Azzameen Station|Alliance counterattack]] came soon after the return of the ''Otana''. Due to the family's familiarity with the station, Emon and Aeron were called in to assist with the Alliance attack. MK-09 would operate the ventral turret on the ''Otana'', though the ship would be piloted by Aeron;<ref name="XWAPrima" /> Emkay's normal flying partner, Ace, would be instead flying a [[A/SF-01 B-wing starfighter/Legends|B-wing starfighter]] with his Alliance squadron. Together with Emon in the ''Andrasta'', the strike team left the ''Liberty'' and made the jump back to the mercenary base. Once there, Aeron spotted uncle Antan's [[Action VI bulk transport/Legends|Action VI transport]] and pointed it out to the other Azzameens, though the ship fled before it could be hailed.<ref name="XWA" />

Once the fighter squadrons diverged on the invaders, Aeron and Emkay targeted the incoming ''Preybird''-class fighters and kept them occupied as the Alliance force moved to eliminate the station's defenses and disable the ''Falcon's Nest'' itself. With the main defenses destroyed, [[Storm Unit (Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport)|Storm Unit]], the [[Gamma-class ATR-6 assault transport|assault transport]] responsible for transporting the strike team intended to capture the base, approached the hangar;<ref name="XWA" /> the arrival of the ''Marauder''-class corvette [[Plague (Marauder-class)|''Plague'']], along with its accompanying squadrons of [[IRD starfighter]]s, forced the ''Otana'', as well as the rest of the fighters in the Alliance force, to engage the corvette and protect the transport. Storm Unit successfully entered the base as the ''Redhawk'' exploded from the Rebel attack. After clearing the base of mercenaries,<ref name="XWAPrima" /> however, the strike force found the station filled with bombs set to explode within around three [[Standard minute/Legends|minutes]].<ref name="XWA" />

Aeron instructed Emkay to dock with the station. Once landed, Aeron made her way to the [[Commando/Legends|commandos]] and aided in diffusing the bomb. [[GAT-12 Skipray Blastboat|Skipray Blastboats]] entered the sector during the boarding operation;<ref name="XWA" /> Emkay took to the immobile ''Otana''{{'s}} turret to protect the transport from the newcomers, allowing enough time for Aeron to successfully disarm the bombs.<ref name="XWAPrima" /> After the battle, the former ''Falcon's Nest'' was returned to the Azzameen family as thanks for their outstanding service as well as assistance in recovering the base.<ref name="XWA" />

MK-09 would once again join in an Alliance task soon after the recapture of Azzameen Station. This time, the droid accompanied Ace, secretly transporting a strike team in the ''Sabra'', to [[Mission to Zhar|secure]] the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class T-4a shuttle]] [[Tydirium/Legends|''Tydirium'']]<ref name="XWA" /> and Imperial codes contained within the vessel<ref name="SWCCS">''[[Star Wars: Complete Cross-Sections]]''</ref> for use in future Alliance missions.<ref name="ROTJ">{{Film|VI}}</ref><ref name="Discrepancy">''[[Star Wars: Rogue Squadron II: Rogue Leader]]'' depicts a much different capture of the same vessel, without giving mention to the Mission to Zhar at all. In a [[September 26]], [[2007]] post on the [[StarWars.com]] [[StarWars.com Message Boards|Message Boards]] ({{SWBoards|url=thread.jspa?threadID=152583&start=1545#16926420|thread=Holocron continuity database questions|user=[[Leland Chee|Leland Y Chee]]|date=2007-09-26|time=5:34 PM}})</ref>, [[Leland Chee]] stated that there were in fact two captures of the same vessel; somewhere along the lines, the commando team used in the Mission to Zhar are captured, and the Tydirium relocated to another Imperial base, where [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] and [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] captured it. This information, however, was contradicted again by ''Star Wars: Complete Cross-Sections'', which states that the Mission to Zhar only captured codes for the shuttle, and not the physical shuttle. This article assumes both the shuttle and codes were captured in the Mission to Zhar and that the ship was lost some time later.<ref name="CCS">''[[Star Wars: Complete Cross-Sections]]'' states that the Mission to Zhar was run to steal access codes aboard the [[Tydirium/Legends|''Tydirium'']] in an attempt to reconcile the conflict of the capture of the [[Lambda-class T-4a shuttle/Legends|''Lambda''-class shuttle]] by two different individuals in two different locations and at two different times.</ref> MK-09 managed communications with Imperial officers as the ''Sabra'' made its way through a customs checkpoint en route to [[Zhar/Legends|Zhar]]; this allowed Ace to concentrate on his piloting, as a passing patrol could identify the ''Sabra''{{'s}} mission. MK-09, successfully bluffing his way through the conversation, was granted the coordinates for the [[Outpost 327|outpost]] where the ''Tydirium'' was docked and the ''Sabra'' left for Zhar.<ref name="XWA" />

Emkay continued to managed communications upon arrival at the outpost. Ace safely docked inside the station and Emkay left the line open as the commandos made their way toward the ''Tydirium''. Once again, Emkay managed to stall the probing [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officer]] long enough for the commandos to finish their mission. However, though the officer may not have realized the real reason for the delay, he did determine it was worth looking into. Ace didn't give the Imperials a chance as he left the hangar, TIE fighters in pursuit. As the ''Tydirium'' exited the station undetected, the ''Sabra'' hailed [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]], which entered the system and engaged the Imperial starfighters. Once the hijacked shuttle made the jump to [[Lightspeed/Legends|lightspeed]], the ''Sabra'' and the Rogues broke their dogfight and exited Zhar space.<ref name="XWA" /><ref name="Discrepancy" /><ref name="CCS" /> Following the completion of the mission, MK-09 noted that the ''Sabra'' had taken several hits in the battle; the maintenance droid lamented that he would have to repair this extensive damage.<ref name="XWAPrima" />

====A fateful reunion====
{{Quote|What were you doing here with the mercenaries?''"<br />"''That is a good question. I took a hit in that fight&mdash;''"<br />"''Shut him off, will you, Aeron?''"<br />"''How rude. I will have you know that I was&hellip;|An angered Emon demands Emkay to be shut off during a tense meeting with Antan|audio=EmkayHowRude-XWA.flac|<ref name="XWA" />}}
Shortly after the Alliance to Restore the Republic began [[Battle of Sullust (4 ABY)|amassing]] their fleet in the [[Sullust system/Legends|Sullust system]] in preparation for a major offensive against the Empire, Antan Azzameen called the Azzameen children to an urgent meeting.<ref name="XWA" /> MK-09 accompanied Ace and Aeron aboard the ''Otana'',<ref name="XWAPrima" /> and arrived at Azzameen Station, where Antan's ''[[Big Score]]'' and Emon awaited them. The Azzameen children and MK-09 immediately demanded answers about Antan's presence in the battle to retake the station, though the overly chatty MK-09 was later switched off at the insistence of short-tempered Emon. The droid remained off for the duration of the conversation; Antan explained that he was working with the Empire in order to restore Twin Suns Transport Services and negotiate the release of Tomaas and Galin, whom Antan revealed were alive, though [[Kessel Station Holding Cell|imprisoned]] in [[Kessel Station]]. Antan insisted that the Azzameen children [[Mission to Kessel Station|depart]] for the [[Kessel system/Legends|Kessel system]] at once as he had organized the captured Azzameens' release. Upon reactivation, Emkay questioned what he had missed; the Azzameens did not immediately respond,<ref name="XWA" /> but the droid learned of the mission and was ecstatic at the prospect of rescuing the lost Azzameens.<ref name="XWAPrima" />

[[File:GeneralAzzameensTrophies-XWA.png|thumb|right|200px|Emkay in Ace's room, immediately following the Battle of Endor]]
The ''Otana'', ''Andrasta'', and ''Big Score'' exited hyperspace near [[Kessel/Legends|Kessel]] and the ''Otana'' docked with the station. Aeron began to slice through the prison records to find Tomaas and Galin, but was unable to find any record of either Azzameen. Building fears for the Azzameen children were soon realized; the ''Imperial II''-class Star Destroyer [[Devastator/Legends|''Devastator'']] arrived and demanded the surrender of the ''Otana'' and ''Andrasta'' while thanking Antan for his betrayal of the rogue Azzameens. As the ''Big Score'' left, MK-09 was tasked with finding a new exit vector, as the Star Destroyer had successfully managed to block the previously calculated coordinates. The task was made much more difficult due to the close presence of [[Maw Cluster/Legends|the Maw]], a multitude of [[Black hole/Legends|black holes]] which made quick hyperspace calculations all but impossible. It was only the timely arrival of the ''Deadman's Hand'' and Dunari that allowed the ''Otana'' to escape; Dunari provided the Azzameen ships coordinates to exit the Kessel system<ref name="XWA" /> and reach the relative safety of an Imperial [[Asteroid/Legends|asteroid]] [[Ore/Legends|ore]] [[Outpost AS-27|processing plant]]. As Ace sped towards a new exit vector, Emkay took to the turret to keep pursuing [[TIE/ad starfighter]]s from attacking the ship.<ref name="XWAPrima" /> Eventually, the ''Otana'', ''Andrasta'', and ''Deadman's Hand'' escaped Kessel space and returned to the ''Liberty''.<ref name="XWA" />

====Aboard the ''Millennium Falcon''====
{{Quote|Gener&hellip; er, Lando asked me if I knew how to reattach a thrust vector magnet in midflight. He muttered something about medical adhesive tape and packing foam. I told him that I didn't, but I knew someone who did. Care to come along?|Ace invites MK-09 to serve aboard the ''Millennium Falcon''|<ref name="XWAPrima" />}}
There was little time to recover from the shock of Antan's betrayal as the Alliance had finished preparations for their full-scale [[Battle of Endor/Legends|assault]] on a new Imperial [[Death Star II/Legends|Death Star]] [[Battle station/Legends|battle station]] under construction in the [[Endor system/Legends|Endor system]]. Ace was assigned to the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']], a YT-1300 light freighter owned by Alliance [[General/Legends|General]] [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]], to be used in the assault on the vulnerable [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]]. Ace later invited MK-09 to serve alongside him aboard the freighter; MK-09, thankful and excited for the chance to destroy a Death Star, agreed.<ref name="XWAPrima" /><ref name="Battle of Endor">''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]''{{'s}} in-flight model of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']] depicts [[Ace Azzameen/Legends|Ace Azzameen]] and MK-09 as [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] and copilot. ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance: Prima's Official Strategy Guide]]'' clarifies MK-09's role in the [[Battle of Endor/Legends|Battle of Endor]] by stating [[Gender/Legends|he]] operated one of the ''Millennium Falcon''{{'s}} [[AG-2G quad laser cannon/Legends|turret guns]].</ref> The ''Millennium Falcon'', piloted by Alliance General [[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian]], entered hyperspace with the rest of the Alliance fleet close behind.<ref name="ROTJ" /> Upon arrival, MK-09 noted the impressive size of the Imperial battlestation as the ''Falcon'' and the rest of the rebel fleet closed upon the Death Star.<ref name="XWAPrima" />

However, the ground mission to destroy the [[Endor shield generator bunker|planetary shield generator]] protecting the second Death Star on the [[Endor/Legends|Forest Moon of Endor]] had been delayed; Lando, sensing that the shield was still raised, called all craft to break their attack as waves of TIE fighters approached the Rebel starfighters.<ref name="ROTJ" /> MK-09 took to the ''Falcon''{{'s}} ventral<ref name="Cracken">The ''[[Rebellion Era Campaign Guide]]'' places [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]] in the dorsal [[Laser turret/Legends|turret]] of the [[Millennium Falcon/Legends|''Millennium Falcon'']].</ref> turret gun,<ref name="XWAPrima" /> assisting fellow turret operator [[Airen Cracken/Legends|Airen Cracken]],<ref name="RECG">''[[Rebellion Era Campaign Guide]]''</ref> to destroy the incoming starfighters. As Calrissian ordered the Alliance fleet to engage the Star Destroyers blockading the system's exit, the droid continued to work the turret gun,<ref name="XWAPrima" /> assisting in the destruction of the Super Star Destroyer ''Executor'' and Imperial Star Destroyer [[Vehement/Legends|''Vehement'']].<ref name="XWA" /> With the shield protecting the station disabled, the ''Falcon'' entered the superstructure and destroyed the Death Star's [[reactor]] core; this led to the destruction of the station entirely and a victory for the Alliance.<ref name="ROTJ" /> Following the battle, MK-09 would continue to visit Ace, now assigned to the Star Cruiser [[Independence/Legends|''Independence'']], as his former home, the ''Liberty'', was destroyed by the second Death Star's [[Superlaser/Legends|superlaser]] during the Battle of Endor.<ref name="XWA" /> Some time later, MK-09 would compile an account of Ace's experiences with the Rebellion and the saga of the Azzameen family.<ref name="XWAPrima" />

==Characteristics==
{{Quote|Do something about that trigger-happy droid, will you?''"<br />"''I can see I'm not wanted here.|Emon, expressing concern about MK-09's aggression circuits|audio=Emkay-TriggerHappyDroid.flac|<ref name="XWA" />}}
MK-09 was a heavily-modified<ref name="XWAPrima" /> Kalibac Industries<ref name="XWA" /> MK-series maintenance droid. Like other droids in the series,<ref name="Scavenger" /> Emkay possessed a single [[Color/Legends|red]] [[Photoreceptor/Legends|photoreceptor]] mounted on the front of his head. A telescoping neck joint allowed the droid to swivel, raise, and lower his head. Located in Emkay's torso was a holoprojector capable of displaying mission briefs and graphic representations of objectives. A pair of tracks mounted to the lower portion of the droid's chassis allowed locomotion. When in space, MK-09 could maneuver without the assistance of an external source; this allowed the droid to accomplish space-based missions, like the recovery of the Azzameen family datacore.<ref name="XWA" />

As a second-degree maintenance droid,<ref name="Scavenger" /> Emkay was utilized to repair vessels such as the family's YT-series freighters following missions. His knowledge also applied to in-flight jobs; for example, he knew how to correctly reattach a YT-1300's [[Thrust vector magnet/Legends|thrust vector magnets]]. Emkay could also use his programming to analyze situations and come to conclusions. Similarly, the droid was often tasked with calculations,<ref name="XWAPrima" /> including plotting safe and accurate routes through hyperspace.<ref name="XWA" /> He was capable of simultaneous route calculation and ship identification. MK-09 possessed a communication system with both internal and external components as well as a [[Memory bank/Legends|memory bank]] capable of storing [[Holodrama/Legends|holofilms]] and experiences. An internal oil-based lubrication system ensured the proper functioning of his components. Emkay had an extensive suite of scanning equipment, including sensors for detecting life aboard starships and ship identification sensors.<ref name="XWAPrima" />

His owners, the Azzameens, heavily modified the droid to serve an expanded role in family affairs. MK-09 was capable of piloting various starships&mdash;mainly freighters and transports,<ref name="XWA" /> though the droid could also pilot one-man starfighters&mdash;due to both internal<ref name="LAWebsite" /> and external modifications. When Tomaas Azzameen felt it time to teach his youngest son, Ace, Emkay was further upgraded; upon Ace's first training mission, Aeron provided the droid with instructions for operating a turret gun. Emkay used these upgrades to protect craft flown by the new pilot.<ref name="XWAPrima" />

===Personality===
{{Quote|Rumor has it that Darth Vader is searching for Luke Skywalker. There is a large bounty for his capture, too. I suppose blowing up the Death Star was bound to attract Vader's attention.<br />I would hate to be him.<br />Actually, I'd hate to be ANY human.|MK-09 shares information with Ace over an e-mail message|<ref name="XWA" />}}
Emkay was a brash, headstrong droid with masculine programming. While copiloting with Ace, the droid frequently looked to engage in dogfights.<ref name="XWA" /> He also expressed a great deal of enjoyment when in battle; this enthusiasm caused those familiar with the droid to often suggest toning down his aggression circuits.<ref name="LAWebsite" /> Even with the aggression shown towards enemies, MK-09 showed kindness and understanding to those near him. MK-09's behavioral processor did not possess an embarrassment program,<ref name="XWA" /> but was capable of feeling pride, both at his own actions and the actions of those close to him. The droid was disappointed at being unable to join the Rebellion officially, and often suggested that enlisting MK-series maintenance droids would greatly benefit the Rebellion's efforts.<ref name="XWAPrima" />

Though he endeared his biological owners,<ref name="XWAPrima" /> MK-09 preferred his status as a droid and commented on this matter several times, both to Ace in an email<ref name="XWA" /> and in his recounting of Ace's adventures. He felt that droids in general were unfairly treated throughout [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and kept notes in a personal "Droid Abuse" diary. In one situation, Emkay expressed his extreme displeasure at an Alliance training mission where the goal of the exercise was the perilous rescue of an [[R2-series astromech droid/Legends|R2-series astromech droid]] stranded in an asteroid processing plant. Though disgusted by the treatment of other droids, Emkay considered his droid model&mdash;the MK-series&mdash; to be superior to other models, including [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droids]].<ref name="XWAPrima" />

MK-09 felt that he personally was not given the credit he deserved for his efforts assisting Ace and the other Azzameens on various missions, and often attributed failures by members of the Azzameen family to their [[Sentience/Legends|organic nature]], stating that a droid could have performed the task with better success. Even so, MK-09 was programmed to be strongly loyal to his owners; this included not only the family but the family's holdings.<ref name="XWAPrima" /> On more than one occasion, Emkay acted as a mediator between his owner's children. However, these attempts were often rebutted back at the droid and met with failure. The droid also attempted to liven grave situations with a witty statement or question; more than once this was also met with friendly hostility,<ref name="XWA" /> such as the disabling of his communication circuits.<ref name="XWAPrima" />

While under the care of Ace Azzameen, MK-09 would inform Ace of different missions and assignments available to him. He also managed Ace's e-mail service&mdash;which he occasionally snooped in (though with good intentions)&mdash;as well as notifying Ace of different trinkets and medals Ace received in his adventures.<ref name="XWA" /> MK-09 regarded normal affairs, such as deliveries and cargo inspections, as mundane and boring. Indeed, he began to resent piloting the ''Otana''&mdash;his favorite ship in the Azzameen fleet&mdash;when acting as a shuttle for Ace.<ref name="XWAPrima" /> However, he still performed his duties with accuracy and a sense of duty. During these runs, he would often utilize small-talk to "encourage" the Azzameens to join the Alliance. Eventually his suggestions were observed by Ace, and other members of the Azzameen family would often assist Alliance efforts on an unofficial basis.<ref name="XWA" />

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|That's the spirit! Kick them where it hurts!|MK-09|audio=EmkayKickThem-XWA.flac|<ref name="XWA" />}}
[[File:EmkayFalcon.jpg|thumb|right|220px|Ace and MK-09 piloting the ''Millennium Falcon'', as it appears in the ''Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance'' engine]]
MK-09 first appeared in the [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance]]'', released in [[1999]]. MK-09's voice was provided by [[Daniel Hagen]]. In the storyline's prologue, the droid functions as a guide to familiarize players with concepts and controls featured in the game. In certain missions, the droid also acts as a voice for the player character Ace and provides feedback and mission guidelines.<ref name="XWA" /> The game's [[Prima Games]] [[Star Wars: X-Wing Alliance: Prima's Official Strategy Guide|strategy guide]] greatly expands on the droid's role in Ace's adventures. This book provides a narrative, written from MK-09's in-universe perspective, which clarifies and expounds on situations experienced in missions, including mission outcomes.<ref name="XWAPrima" />

In ''X-Wing Alliance''{{'s}} final storyline mission, the in-flight model of the ''Millennium Falcon'' places Ace and MK-09 as pilot and copilot respectively.<ref name="XWA" /> This contradicts established [[canon]] from the [[1983]] [[original trilogy]] film, [[Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi|''Star Wars'': Episode VI ''Return of the Jedi'']], which shows Lando Calrissian and [[Nien Nunb/Legends|Nien Nunb]] at the helm.<ref name="ROTJ" /> The game's Prima strategy guide helps clarify the roles of both Ace and MK-09: Ace pilots the ''Millennium Falcon'' at crucial points during the battle as General Calrissian commands the rest of the fleet, and MK-09 operates one of the turret guns.<ref name="XWAPrima" /> While Ace's placement is still contradicted, MK-09's placement does not contradict nor interfere with other sources.<ref name="XWAPrima" /><ref name="ROTJ" />
